# Copy this file to ~/.claude/public-repo-identifiers.txt and replace these
# made-up examples with your own. The pre-push check
# (.github/scripts/pre_push_check.py) stops a push whose commits contain any of them.
# Keep the real file out of the repo: the list is itself personal.
#
# One fixed string per line, matched without regard to case. Lines starting
# with # are comments. Links to this repo on GitHub may hold your GitHub
# username; the check allows that.

# Your username on this computer, which shows up in absolute paths
your-pc-username

# Your real name and your email addresses or email provider
Your Real Name
your-email-provider

# Your GitHub username and numeric id
your-github-username
12345678

# Private repos, projects, games and services you use
your-private-repo
your-game-name

# To catch every email address, add a line holding only the at sign.
